title: The milk is where the truck is #shorts
description:
Grade "A" milk is cooled to 7C (45F) or less and kept there (FACT, Pasteurized Milk Ordinance, here via Maine 01-001 CMR ch. 329). A Wegmans manager said the layout keeps the cold chain unbroken (NPR Planet Money, Episode 555, 2016).

The whole story: https://www.youtube.com/@zerounderstands

#shorts #howitworks #supermarket
